title: glsl_tesseval
description: load a GLSL tessellation evaluation shader

messages.description: shader ID, to be linked with [glsl_program]

arguments.description: tessellation evaluation shader file to load

methods.description: load a tessellation evaluation shader file

body: [glsl_tesseval] loads a GLSL tessellation evaluation shader. Send the resulting shader ID to [glsl_program] to link it into a shader program.
